content.thinking: Two issues in my test script: I passed str instead of bytes for one case, and the `chk` for "bad-utf8" also passes bytes (fine). Let me fix the trailing-comma case to bytes and also fix the `_DEL` usage (I never use it). Let me also guard the subprocess call.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='tmp/t_valid.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('chk("trailing-comma", jtext(GOOD)[:-1].replace(\'"rounds": [\',\'"rounds": [\')+\'}]\', True)',
            'chk("trailing-comma", (jtext(GOOD)[:-1]+"]}").encode(), True)')
s=s.replace('p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"], input=data, capture_output=True)',
            'if isinstance(data,str): data=data.encode()\n    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"], input=data, capture_output=True)')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 tmp/t_valid.py 2>&1 | grep -v '^PASS'; echo "== total:"; python3 tmp/t_valid.py 2>&1 | grep -c PASS
